summary: Iteration 66 - Capability System Expansion (DB-Backed Presets, Auto-Assign Rules, Bulk Apply, Audit Logging): All 29 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified all 3 new admin tabs (Presets, Auto-Rules, Roles & Caps with bulk apply). Fixed critical bug: missing SelectValue import in RolesCapsPanel.js causing crash.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing SelectValue import causing 'SelectValue is not defined' error when clicking user checkbox

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed missing SelectValue import in RolesCapsPanel.js - was causing runtime crash when selecting users for bulk apply
seed_data_creation: Test users and rules created during backend tests (cleaned up after each test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 66 added 4 major capability system features: (B) Auto-Assign Rule Engine with CRUD and run endpoints, (C) Audit logging for all capability changes in db.audit_logs, (D) DB-backed Preset Editor with CRUD for custom presets (13 builtin presets seeded), (E) Bulk Apply presets to multiple users. All features working correctly. Fixed critical bug in RolesCapsPanel.js (missing SelectValue import). Admin tabs: Presets (/admin?tab=presets), Auto-Rules (/admin?tab=auto-rules), Roles & Caps (/admin?tab=roles-caps) all functional.

db_backed_presets.list_presets: Returns 13+ builtin presets with builtin=true flag
db_backed_presets.create_custom: Creates preset with auto-gen custom_xxxxxxxx ID, filters invalid caps
db_backed_presets.update_builtin_blocked: Returns 403 'Built-in Presets koennen nicht geaendert werden'

bulk_apply.apply_to_users: POST /admin/presets/{id}/apply-to-users merges caps to all specified users

cap_rules_crud.create_rule: Creates rule with auto-gen rule_xxxxxxxx ID
cap_rules_crud.validation: Requires preset_id or caps in apply field

rule_engine.run_single: POST /admin/cap-rules/run with rule_id runs only that rule

audit_logging.set_caps: Creates audit log entry with category='capabilities'

regression.simulate_user: Returns detailed breakdown with role_defaults, groups, grants, denies, effective
regression.expires_support: cap_expires field working for time-limited grants

frontend_ui.presets_tab: PresetEditorPanel renders with 13 builtin presets, create/edit/delete buttons
frontend_ui.roles_caps_bulk: Bulk bar appears with preset select and apply button when users selected
